register.description: This register is used to configure R5SS0 in Lock step or Dual core mode. The mode change can be affected only once in a SOC power cycle.

bitfield.description: Writing 3'b111 enables a single cycle wait state with respect to CR5A_clk for rom access.This needs to be set when R5 clock is at 400MHZ and Interconnect-clk is at 200MHZ. [because it is a timing issue in this scenario]
Write pulse bit field:Writing 3'b111 will trigger the reset FSM. Reset FSM ensures reset to R5SS and inturn ensures the latching of lock_step and also mem_swap bit
Writing 3'b111 ensures switch happens only after R5SS reset. Orelse it will be a immediate switch.

Writing 3'b000 ensures R5 to be in Dual-Core mode. Note: The change happens after the R5SS reset assertion if corresponding R5SS_CONTROL_LOCK_STEP_SWITCH_WAIT is set. Or else the switiching to Dual-core happens on the fly.

register.description: This register shows whether R5SS0 is in Lock step or Dual core mode.

bitfield.description: Reading1:confirms R5SS is in lockstep mode. Reading0:confirms R5SS is in Dual-core mode.
Reading1:confirms ROM is Eclipsed from with RAM for R5.

register.description: This register controls the default burst size of EDMA TPTC.

bitfield.description: DBS [default burst size] tieoff value for TPTC A1. DBS tieoff defines optimally sized cmd.Both the read and write controller will always issue commands that are less than or equal to the DBS tieoff value. This will typically be on the order of 4 or 8 dataphases worth of data. DBS must always be tied off to no larger than half of the Channel FIFO size. Set DBS to -2'b00 = 16 byte 2'b01 = 32 byte 2'b10 = 64 byte 2'b11 = 128 byte

DBS [default burst size] tieoff value for TPTC A0. DBS tieoff defines optimally sized cmd.Both the read and write controller will always issue commands that are less than or equal to the DBS tieoff value. This will typically be on the order of 4 or 8 dataphases worth of data. DBS must always be tied off to no larger than half of the Channel FIFO size. Set DBS to -2'b00 = 16 byte 2'b01 = 32 byte 2'b10 = 64 byte 2'b11 = 128 byte

register.description: This register is used to Globally enable Interconnect Safety.

bitfield.description: Set this bit to 3'b111 to Globally enable Interconnect Safety. Set this bit to 3'b000 to globally disable the Interconnect safety.

register.description: This register is used to Control and Configure the Interconnect Safety Behaviour of R5SS0 CORE0 AXI RD Initiator Port.

bitfield.description: This bitfield gives a top level idea of the available bus [cmd,wr,ws,rd] for the particular Target/Initiator and whether it follows the VBUS protocol or not. Bit 0 - 1'b1 indicates the Command bus is implemented to this target/initiator else it is set to 1'b0. Bit 1 - 1'b1 indicates the write bus is implemented to this target/initiator else it is set to 1'b0. Bit 2 - 1'b1 indicates the write status bus is implemented to this target/initiator else it is set to 1'b0. Bit 3 - 1'b1 indicates the read bus is implemented to this target/initiator else it is set to 1'b0. Bit 4 - 1'b0 indicates the port follows the VBUS protocol else it is set to 1'b1. Bits 5-7 are set to 3'b000.
Set this bit to 1'b1 to clear the error status for this port
Set this bit to 3'b111 to enable the safety configuration for this port. Set this bit to 3'b000 to disable the safety configuration for this port.

register.description: This register is used to Inject fault on the Interconnect Safety comparator of R5SS0 CORE0 AXI RD Initiator Port.

bitfield.description: This bitfield is used to inject fault on Read, write, command and request bus on the safe Interconnect. Bit 0 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Command bus. Bit 1 - Set this bit to inject fault on theWrite bus. Bit 2 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Write Status bus.Bit 3 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Read bus. Bit 7- Set this bit to inject fault on the corresponding request bus.

This bitfield is used to inject fault on Read, write, command and request bus on the main Interconnect.Bit 0 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Command bus. Bit 1 - Set this bit to inject fault on theWrite bus. Bit 2 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Write Status bus.Bit 3 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Read bus. Bit 7- Set this bit to inject fault on the corresponding request bus.
Set bit 0 to 1'b1 to inject sec and ded faults on [31:0] bits of data bus.Set bit 1 to 1'b1 to inject sec and ded faults on [64:32] bits of data bus.
Set this bit to 1'b1 inject ded error on data at this port
Set this bit to 1'b1 to inject sec error on data at this port

Set this bit 1'b1 to inject fault for request signals on Safe Interconnect. This is enabled only when the 7th bit of safe bitfield of this register and particular bit coressponding to this port on the safe bitfield of this register is set HIGH

Set this bit to 1'b1 to inject fault for request signals on main Interconnect. This is enabled only when the 7th bit of main bitfield of this register and particular bit coressponding to this port on the main bitfield of this register is set HIGH
This is a global safe Fault injection signal. Set this bit to inject fault on all the safety buses of the safe interconnect except req signal. Writing a 1'b1 injects fault on interconnect.
This is a global main Fault injection signal. Set this bit to inject fault on all the buses of the main interconnect except req signal. Writing a 1'b1 injects fault on interconnect.

register.description: This Register provides the Error Status of Bus Safety Comparator of R5SS0 CORE0 AXI RD Initiator port.

bitfield.description: This flag signals detection of dual error in Data at this port.Flag is generted for 32 bit segment of Data BusBit 0 - 1'b1 indicates ded on [31:0] bit of Data busBit 1 - 1'b1 indicates ded on [63:32] bit of Data busBit [7:2] - Unused. Set to 1'b0

This flag signals detection of single error in Data at this port. Flag is generted for 32 bit segment of Data BusBit 0 - 1'b1 indicates sec on [31:0] bit of Data busBit 1 - 1'b1 indicates sec on [63:32] bit of Data busBit [7:2] - Unused. Set to 1'b0

This is used to verify the proper functioning of fault Injection on all the buses.1'b1 indicates error in the corresponding Bus has been injected successfully. Bit 0 - This is a Bitwise AND of error compares of all command bus signals.Bit 1 - This is a Bitwise AND of error compares of all write bus signals.Bit 2 - This is a Bitwise AND of error compares of all write status bus signals.Bit 3 - This is a Bitwise AND of error compares of all read bus signals.Bits [7:4] are unused.

1'b1 indicates error in the corresponding Bus whenever a fault is detected at any bus signalBit 0 - This is a Bitwise OR of error compares of all command bus signals.Bit 1 - This is a Bitwise OR of error compares of all write bus signals.Bit 2 - This is a Bitwise OR of error compares of all write status bus signals.Bit 3 - This is a Bitwise OR of error compares of all read bus signals.Bits [7:4] are unused.

register.description: This register Indicates the Error Syndrome of Data errors in Bus Safety Comparator of R5SS0 CORE0 AXI RD Initiator Port.

bitfield.description: Read this bitfield for Comparator status for Higher 32 bits [63:32] of data bus at this port. It represent the position of the flipped bit in case of SEC.

This flag signals detection of single error in Data at this port. Flag is generted for 32 bit segment of Data BusBit 0 - 1'b1 indicates sec on [31:0] bit of Data busBit 1 - 1'b1 indicates sec on [63:32] bit of Data busBit [7:2] - Unused. Set to 1'b0

This is used to verify the proper functioning of fault Injection on all the buses.1'b1 indicates error in the corresponding Bus has been injected successfully. Bit 0 - This is a Bitwise AND of error compares of all command bus signals.Bit 1 - This is a Bitwise AND of error compares of all write bus signals.Bit 2 - This is a Bitwise AND of error compares of all write status bus signals.Bit 3 - This is a Bitwise AND of error compares of all read bus signals.Bits [7:4] are unused.

1'b1 indicates error in the corresponding Bus whenever a fault is detected at any bus signalBit 0 - This is a Bitwise OR of error compares of all command bus signals.Bit 1 - This is a Bitwise OR of error compares of all write bus signals.Bit 2 - This is a Bitwise OR of error compares of all write status bus signals.Bit 3 - This is a Bitwise OR of error compares of all read bus signals.Bits [7:4] are unused.

register.description: This register is used to Control and Configure the Interconnect Safety Behaviour of ICSSM Target Port.

bitfield.description: This bitfield gives a top level idea of the available bus [cmd,wr,ws,rd] for the particular Target/Initiator and whether it follows the VBUS protocol or not. Bit 0 - 1'b1 indicates the Command bus is implemented to this target/initiator else it is set to 1'b0. Bit 1 - 1'b1 indicates the write bus is implemented to this target/initiator else it is set to 1'b0. Bit 2 - 1'b1 indicates the write status bus is implemented to this target/initiator else it is set to 1'b0. Bit 3 - 1'b1 indicates the read bus is implemented to this target/initiator else it is set to 1'b0. Bit 4 - 1'b0 indicates the port follows the VBUS protocol else it is set to 1'b1. Bits 5-7 are set to 3'b000.
Set this bit to 1'b1 to clear the error status for this port
Set this bit to 3'b111 to enable the safety configuration for this port. Set this bit to 3'b000 to disable the safety configuration for this port.

register.description: This register is used to Inject fault on the Interconnect Safety comparator of ICSSM Target Port.

bitfield.description: This bitfield is used to inject fault on Read, write, command and request bus on the safe Interconnect. Bit 0 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Command bus. Bit 1 - Set this bit to inject fault on theWrite bus. Bit 2 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Write Status bus.Bit 3 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Read bus. Bit 7- Set this bit to inject fault on the corresponding request bus.

This bitfield is used to inject fault on Read, write, command and request bus on the main Interconnect.Bit 0 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Command bus. Bit 1 - Set this bit to inject fault on theWrite bus. Bit 2 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Write Status bus.Bit 3 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Read bus. Bit 7- Set this bit to inject fault on the corresponding request bus.
Set bit 0 to 1'b1 to inject sec and ded faults on [31:0] bits of data bus.Set bit 1 to 1'b1 to inject sec and ded faults on [64:32] bits of data bus.
Set this bit to 1'b1 inject ded error on data at this port
Set this bit to 1'b1 to inject sec error on data at this port

Set this bit 1'b1 to inject fault for request signals on Safe Interconnect. This is enabled only when the 7th bit of safe bitfield of this register and particular bit coressponding to this port on the safe bitfield of this register is set HIGH

Set this bit to 1'b1 to inject fault for request signals on main Interconnect. This is enabled only when the 7th bit of main bitfield of this register and particular bit coressponding to this port on the main bitfield of this register is set HIGH
This is a global safe Fault injection signal. Set this bit to inject fault on all the safety buses of the safe interconnect except req signal. Writing a 1'b1 injects fault on interconnect.
This is a global main Fault injection signal. Set this bit to inject fault on all the buses of the main interconnect except req signal. Writing a 1'b1 injects fault on interconnect.

This flag signals detection of single error in Data at this port. Flag is generted for 32 bit segment of Data BusBit 0 - 1'b1 indicates sec on [31:0] bit of Data busBit 1 - 1'b1 indicates sec on [63:32] bit of Data busBit [7:2] - Unused. Set to 1'b0

This is used to verify the proper functioning of fault Injection on all the buses.1'b1 indicates error in the corresponding Bus has been injected successfully. Bit 0 - This is a Bitwise AND of error compares of all command bus signals.Bit 1 - This is a Bitwise AND of error compares of all write bus signals.Bit 2 - This is a Bitwise AND of error compares of all write status bus signals.Bit 3 - This is a Bitwise AND of error compares of all read bus signals.Bits [7:4] are unused.

1'b1 indicates error in the corresponding Bus whenever a fault is detected at any bus signalBit 0 - This is a Bitwise OR of error compares of all command bus signals.Bit 1 - This is a Bitwise OR of error compares of all write bus signals.Bit 2 - This is a Bitwise OR of error compares of all write status bus signals.Bit 3 - This is a Bitwise OR of error compares of all read bus signals.Bits [7:4] are unused.

register.description: This register is used to Control and Configure the Interconnect Safety Behaviour of MBOX SRAM Target Port.

bitfield.description: This bitfield gives a top level idea of the available bus [cmd,wr,ws,rd] for the particular Target/Initiator and whether it follows the VBUS protocol or not. Bit 0 - 1'b1 indicates the Command bus is implemented to this target/initiator else it is set to 1'b0. Bit 1 - 1'b1 indicates the write bus is implemented to this target/initiator else it is set to 1'b0. Bit 2 - 1'b1 indicates the write status bus is implemented to this target/initiator else it is set to 1'b0. Bit 3 - 1'b1 indicates the read bus is implemented to this target/initiator else it is set to 1'b0. Bit 4 - 1'b0 indicates the port follows the VBUS protocol else it is set to 1'b1. Bits 5-7 are set to 3'b000.
Set this bit to 1'b1 to clear the error status for this port
Set this bit to 3'b111 to enable the safety configuration for this port. Set this bit to 3'b000 to disable the safety configuration for this port.

register.description: This register is used to Inject fault on the Interconnect Safety comparator of MBOX SRAM Target Port.

bitfield.description: This bitfield is used to inject fault on Read, write, command and request bus on the safe Interconnect. Bit 0 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Command bus. Bit 1 - Set this bit to inject fault on theWrite bus. Bit 2 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Write Status bus.Bit 3 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Read bus. Bit 7- Set this bit to inject fault on the corresponding request bus.

This bitfield is used to inject fault on Read, write, command and request bus on the main Interconnect.Bit 0 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Command bus. Bit 1 - Set this bit to inject fault on theWrite bus. Bit 2 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Write Status bus.Bit 3 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Read bus. Bit 7- Set this bit to inject fault on the corresponding request bus.
Set bit 0 to 1'b1 to inject sec and ded faults on [31:0] bits of data bus.Set bit 1 to 1'b1 to inject sec and ded faults on [64:32] bits of data bus.
Set this bit to 1'b1 inject ded error on data at this port
Set this bit to 1'b1 to inject sec error on data at this port

Set this bit 1'b1 to inject fault for request signals on Safe Interconnect. This is enabled only when the 7th bit of safe bitfield of this register and particular bit coressponding to this port on the safe bitfield of this register is set HIGH

Set this bit to 1'b1 to inject fault for request signals on main Interconnect. This is enabled only when the 7th bit of main bitfield of this register and particular bit coressponding to this port on the main bitfield of this register is set HIGH
This is a global safe Fault injection signal. Set this bit to inject fault on all the safety buses of the safe interconnect except req signal. Writing a 1'b1 injects fault on interconnect.
This is a global main Fault injection signal. Set this bit to inject fault on all the buses of the main interconnect except req signal. Writing a 1'b1 injects fault on interconnect.

This flag signals detection of single error in Data at this port. Flag is generted for 32 bit segment of Data BusBit 0 - 1'b1 indicates sec on [31:0] bit of Data busBit 1 - 1'b1 indicates sec on [63:32] bit of Data busBit [7:2] - Unused. Set to 1'b0

This is used to verify the proper functioning of fault Injection on all the buses.1'b1 indicates error in the corresponding Bus has been injected successfully. Bit 0 - This is a Bitwise AND of error compares of all command bus signals.Bit 1 - This is a Bitwise AND of error compares of all write bus signals.Bit 2 - This is a Bitwise AND of error compares of all write status bus signals.Bit 3 - This is a Bitwise AND of error compares of all read bus signals.Bits [7:4] are unused.

1'b1 indicates error in the corresponding Bus whenever a fault is detected at any bus signalBit 0 - This is a Bitwise OR of error compares of all command bus signals.Bit 1 - This is a Bitwise OR of error compares of all write bus signals.Bit 2 - This is a Bitwise OR of error compares of all write status bus signals.Bit 3 - This is a Bitwise OR of error compares of all read bus signals.Bits [7:4] are unused.
Read this bitfield for Comparator status for Higher 32 bits [63:32] of data bus at this port. It represent the position of the flipped bit in case of SEC.
Read this bitfield for Comparator status for lower 32 bits [31:0] of data bus at this port. It represent the position of the flipped bit in case of SEC.
Read this bitfield for comparator status for command bus for this port. 1'b1 on any of the bits indicates an error on Command Bus
Read this bitfield for comparator status for Write bus for this port. 1'b1 at any bit indicates error on Write Bus
Read this bitfield for comapartor status for read signals at this port. 1'b1 on any of the bits indicates an error on Read bus.
Read this bitfield for comparator status for Write response bus for this port. 1'b1 at any bit indicates error on Write Response Bus.

register.description: This register is used to Control and Configure the Interconnect Safety Behaviour of R5SS0 CORE1 Peripheral Port.

bitfield.description: This bitfield gives a top level idea of the available bus [cmd,wr,ws,rd] for the particular Target/Initiator and whether it follows the VBUS protocol or not. Bit 0 - 1'b1 indicates the Command bus is implemented to this target/initiator else it is set to 1'b0. Bit 1 - 1'b1 indicates the write bus is implemented to this target/initiator else it is set to 1'b0. Bit 2 - 1'b1 indicates the write status bus is implemented to this target/initiator else it is set to 1'b0. Bit 3 - 1'b1 indicates the read bus is implemented to this target/initiator else it is set to 1'b0. Bit 4 - 1'b0 indicates the port follows the VBUS protocol else it is set to 1'b1. Bits 5-7 are set to 3'b000.
Set this bit to 1'b1 to clear the error status for this port
Set this bit to 3'b111 to enable the safety configuration for this port. Set this bit to 3'b000 to disable the safety configuration for this port.

register.description: This register is used to Inject fault on the Interconnect Safety comparator of R5SS0 CORE1 Peripheral Port.

bitfield.description: This bitfield is used to inject fault on Read, write, command and request bus on the safe Interconnect. Bit 0 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Command bus. Bit 1 - Set this bit to inject fault on theWrite bus. Bit 2 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Write Status bus.Bit 3 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Read bus. Bit 7- Set this bit to inject fault on the corresponding request bus.

This bitfield is used to inject fault on Read, write, command and request bus on the main Interconnect.Bit 0 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Command bus. Bit 1 - Set this bit to inject fault on theWrite bus. Bit 2 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Write Status bus.Bit 3 - Set this bit to inject fault on the Read bus. Bit 7- Set this bit to inject fault on the corresponding request bus.
Set bit 0 to 1'b1 to inject sec and ded faults on [31:0] bits of data bus.Set bit 1 to 1'b1 to inject sec and ded faults on [64:32] bits of data bus.
Set this bit to 1'b1 inject ded error on data at this port
Set this bit to 1'b1 to inject sec error on data at this port

Set this bit 1'b1 to inject fault for request signals on Safe Interconnect. This is enabled only when the 7th bit of safe bitfield of this register and particular bit coressponding to this port on the safe bitfield of this register is set HIGH

Set this bit to 1'b1 to inject fault for request signals on main Interconnect. This is enabled only when the 7th bit of main bitfield of this register and particular bit coressponding to this port on the main bitfield of this register is set HIGH
This is a global safe Fault injection signal. Set this bit to inject fault on all the safety buses of the safe interconnect except req signal. Writing a 1'b1 injects fault on interconnect.
This is a global main Fault injection signal. Set this bit to inject fault on all the buses of the main interconnect except req signal. Writing a 1'b1 injects fault on interconnect.
